assistworld-assist-world:lever:becf57a4-.title: Accounting Virtual Assistant (QBO, Ramp & Gusto)
assistworld-assist-world:lever:becf57a4-.description: About the Business You will be supporting a CPA who serves as CFO of a family-owned construction firm while also running a newly launched furniture retail store. The businesses are growing quickly, and the owner needs a trusted accounting partner who can take the day-to-day financial load off their plate — freeing them to focus on leadership and business development. There are also rental property entities in the mix, adding variety to the books you will manage. Overview We are seeking a meticulous and experienced Accounting Virtual Assistant to support a business owner managing finances across multiple entities. This is a full-time, long-term role for someone who can step in immediately and take confident ownership of day-to-day accounting operations with minimal supervision. This is not a generalist admin role. You must have direct, hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online, Ramp, and Gusto. If you are not already proficient in all three, this is not the right fit. Key Responsibilities Bookkeeping & Financial Management (CORE) Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple entities in QuickBooks Online (QBO) Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations Handle accounts payable and receivable, including vendor and supplier billing Generate financial reports (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) on a regular cadence Maintain organised, audit-ready financial records and documentation Expense & Card Management Administer corporate card spending and expense management via Ramp Review and categorise transactions, enforce spend policies, and flag discrepancies Ensure expenses sync accurately with QBO Payroll & HR Administration Process payroll and manage employee records in Gusto Support onboarding of new employees and contractors within Gusto Manage pay schedules and ensure timely, accurate payroll runs Reporting & Operations Track financial KPIs and assist with reporting as needed Provide regular summaries and flag anything requiring the owner's attention Handle ad hoc accounting, admin, and financial tasks as they arise Requirements (MUST-HAVE) 3+ years of experience in a bookkeeping, accounting VA, or finance support role Hands-on, proven proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) — ESSENTIAL Direct experience using Ramp for expense and corporate card management — ESSENTIAL Working knowledge of Gusto for payroll processing and employee administration — ESSENTIAL Comfortable managing finances across multiple entities simultaneously Strong attention to detail with a high standard of accuracy Fluent English — written and verbal Able to work independently, take initiative, and meet deadlines without hand-holding Available to start immediately and commit to a full-time, long-term engagement Non-Negotiables Candidates must have real, verifiable experience with all three of the following: QuickBooks Online (QBO) Ramp Gusto Nice to Have Experience supporting a U.S.-based business remotely Familiarity with accounting for real estate or rental properties Exposure to construction industry financials QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification or equivalent bookkeeping qualification Experience with other finance tools (e.g., Bill.com, Stripe, Expensify) Working Style Comfortable managing multiple entities and varied financial tasks Proactive — flags issues before they become problems Trustworthy with sensitive financial data Thrives with autonomy and clear SOPs Early riser preferred — owner works from approximately 5:00 AM CT

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2752dd35-7232-.title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2752dd35-7232-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in United Arab Emirates. This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community. You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization. The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes. You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations. The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones. You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences. Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement. Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion. Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement. Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features. Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance. Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification. Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture. Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments. Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality. Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment. Requirements Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x , including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android. Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers. Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider , as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation. Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies. Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups. Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage. Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices. Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes. Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team. Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills. Benefits Fully remote, full-time working opportunity. Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employm

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:59a35e98-18c4-48c.title: Founding Engineer - FlowGen Labs
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:59a35e98-18c4-48c.description: ABOUT US We are a well-funded SF Bay Area startup backed by tier-1 investors. We’re a small, cracked team in stealth, building an agentic platform for the hardest, least glamorous, but most valuable, software problems inside the Global 2000. Think decades-old business logic, mission-critical systems, and colossal codebases where every percent of reliability matters. Our product blends program analysis, developer tooling, and code generation to turn multi-year enterprise transformations into something teams can do in a fraction of the time, with verification, auditability, and real-world guarantees. Join a talent-dense founding team with meaningful equity and real growth upside at the intersection of ERP and artificial intelligence. ROLE SUMMARY As our Founding Engineer, you will own a zero-to-one product and its infrastructure. You will build the secure connector and runtime that understands complex enterprise systems, the tooling experience developers use every day, and the analysis and planning engine that transforms legacy code. You will work directly with customers on high-leverage projects and help define our culture, our engineering bar, and our roadmap. - Design the agentic layer. Implement self-checking, reflection, and verification passes before results reach humans or downstream systems - Experience orchestrating agentic workflows and retrieval augmented generation. Familiarity with LangGraph is a plus. - Stand up inference paths with low latency serving and token-level observability - Productionize prompt pipelines, retrieval, and light fine-tuning, where it moves the needle - Hands-on use of AI tools with clear ideas for applying AI to development, testing, data, and support. - Ownership mentality, crisp communication, and comfortable making decisions with 80 percent information. - Move fast without breaking things, not afraid to learn new stacks, bring a we will figure it out attitude. WHY JOIN - Direct product and company impact with minimal bureaucracy. - High bar for craft, velocity, and pragmatic shipping. LOGISTICS - Total compensation: $240,000 to $400,000 - Base salary: $160,000 to $250,000 plus meaningful founding equity - Location: In person, San Francisco Bay Area - Visa Support/Sponsorship available

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:3d0ae18c-b52e-481d.title: Fuel Truck Driver
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:3d0ae18c-b52e-481d.description: Fuel Truck Driver Location: Richmond, VA Job Type: Direct Hire Rate: Starts at $24.00/Hour and may be higher depending on experience. Job Summary We are seeking a skilled and safety-conscious Fuel/Lube Truck Driver to join our team. This position is responsible for delivering fuel and lubricants to heavy equipment and trucks on various job sites, ensuring timely service and compliance with all safety and environmental regulations. Valid Class B CDL with Hazmat and Tanker endorsements (required). 2+ years of commercial driving experience. Clean driving record and ability to pass DOT physical and drug screening. Knowledge of fuel handling procedures and safety protocols. Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently. Physical ability to lift up to 100 lbs and work in outdoor conditions. Operate fuel/lube truck to deliver petroleum products and lubricants to equipment and designated locations. Perform daily pre-trip and post-trip inspections of the truck and equipment. Maintain accurate delivery logs and inventory records. Follow all DOT, OSHA, and company safety standards. Assist with routine maintenance and cleaning of the truck and fueling equipment. Communicate effectively with dispatch and site supervisors regarding delivery schedules. Safely navigate active construction sites and work around moving equipment. Adhere to spill prevention and response procedures; immediately report any leaks or spills. Weekly Pay Company Profit Sharing Plan Paid holidays and Vacation Pay Medical, Dental, Vision and HRA Reimbursement On-time bonus Safety Bonus Full time Overtime available Monday-Friday Occasional Saturday Lift, push, or pull up to 50–100 lbs regularly (hoses, nozzles, spill kits, etc.). Climb in and out of the fuel truck multiple times per shift (cab height + access ladder on tank). Bend, kneel, crouch, and reach to attach hoses, open fuel caps, and perform inspections. Stand and walk on uneven ground and around heavy equipment for extended periods. Operate heavy hose lines (often 1"–2" diameter, 20–50 ft hoses) requiring upper-body strength. Tolerate exposure to diesel/gasoline odors, fumes, weather conditions, and noisy environments. Good hand-eye coordination for controlling fuel flow and operating valves. Ability to wear PPE such as gloves, safety glasses, hard hats, and reflective vests. Work performed outdoors in heat, cold, rain, mud, dust, and on uneven terrain. Frequent exposure to moving construction equipment and traffic. Work may begin early mornings, late evenings, or involve overtime/weekends depending on project needs. Dental insurance Disability insurance Health insurance Life insurance Paid time off Vision insurance

ryzlabs-ryzlabs:lever:21bfb6bf-9b64-40d7.description: Remote role - LATAM only About the role As a Senior NetSuite Consultant at our client's team, you will be the primary functional lead for clients in the manufacturing, Field Services Management, and wholesale distribution sectors. You will own the project lifecycle from discovery and design, to configuration and UAT; ensuring that complex business processes are translated into scalable NetSuite solutions. This is a high-impact role requiring the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, agile environment. Responsibilities: • Lead client discovery sessions to map manufacturing and distribution business requirements to NetSuite best practice. Manage and deliver complex NetSuite implementation projects, including solution design and project management. • Identify and communicate project limitations, shortcomings, and issues early on, working closely with senior consultants and architects to address and mitigate risks. • Execute end-to-end configuration, including complex business logic, custom fields, and workflows. • Act as a subject matter expert for manufacturing processes (e.g., Shop Floor, Control, BOM management), distribution workflows (e.g., Pick/Pack/Ship, Demand Planning). • Guide clients on industry-leading practices for cost accounting, landed costs, preventive maintenance, WIP & Routing, Demand Planning and inventory valuation. • Design and lead internal QA and guide client User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system stability and data integrity. • Delegate tasks to analysts and guide their development to ensure high-quality project deliverables. • Proactively identify and mitigate project risks related to scope, budget, or technical constraints with the project management team. Raise design risks, constraints, and critical dependencies to senior consultants and architects, working together to address and mitigate issues. Basic Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent experience. • 5+ years of experience implementing NetSuite, specifically within the Manufacturing/Wholesale Distribution/FSM processes • Strong understanding of NetSuite core configuration, including complex business logic • Knowledge of Waterfall/agile methodology. • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with clients and team members. • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. • Proficient in spreadsheet-level data transformations. • Familiarity with leading practices within the NetSuite ecosystem. southparkcommons-junior-ai:ashbyhq:2d079.title: Data Scientist - Commercial Analytics
southparkcommons-junior-ai:ashbyhq:2d079.description: ABOUT JUNIOR We’re building cutting-edge LLM-powered workflow tools to supercharge investment research for private market investors. Our clients include most of the global top 10 private equity and consulting firms - Junior already powers hundreds of billions of dollars invested annually. We’re a profitable, bootstrapped company with a growing team of 40+ based in London, NYC and Sydney. We 10x’d our revenue in 2025. You can read more about the company mission & values here https://myjunior.notion.site/join-junior-2026?source=copy_link. ROLE DESCRIPTION As our first data scientist in London, you’ll turn Junior’s product usage, customer, and commercial data into the insights that drive our next phase of growth. Right now, our commercial and product teams are making decisions with incomplete information — you’ll fix that. SAMPLE SET OF PROJECTS - Revenue / cashflow forecasting: develop a model to forecast usage-based revenue and cashflow based on usage data from our product - Feature adoption & engagement analysis: identify which features drive retention and which are dead weight — slice by firm type, user role, and tenure to give our Product team clear prioritisation signals. - Churn & health scoring: build a customer health model that scores accounts by risk using product usage signals (logins, feature depth, search volume) and flags at-risk accounts to Customer Success before they churn. - CRM data quality & enrichment: audit and clean our CRM data, build pipelines to keep it in sync with product usage, and ensure our Sales team always has accurate, up-to-date context on every account. - Sales funnel analysis: map our full acquisition funnel from first touch to closed-won, identify where deals are stalling, and surface the product usage patterns that predict conversion. - Executive reporting: build a weekly data digest for leadership covering revenue, usage, pipeline health and key anomalies — replacing ad hoc spreadsheets with a reliable, automated view of the business. ABOUT YOU We’re looking for a data scientist who loves getting into the detail of how a product is actually being used — and translating that into decisions: - Based in London, in our Farringdon office 5 days / week - Strong command of SQL — you should be fast and confident querying complex, messy, real-world datasets - Proficient in Python for data wrangling, analysis and visualisation (pandas, matplotlib / plotly etc.) - Experience with a BI or dashboarding tool — Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or similar - Has worked with product analytics platforms like Amplitude, Mixpanel, or equivalent — comfortable with event-level data and funnel analysis - Comfortable working directly with CRM data - Strong communicator who can tell a clear story with data - AI-forward: experience vibe coding and using AI tools - Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity - Bonus points for experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or enterprise software where usage data is complex and customer segments vary widely WHY JUNIOR - Top 1% traction: 0-20+ m rev in 3 years, fully bootstrapped / profitable, top-tier customers inc. some of MBB, Big 4, Top 5 PE mega-funds - Flat org structure: lean startup environment with ≤1 manager between each role and the c-suite - Competitive salary + equity and first-class benefits inc: - Team lunch provided everyday at the London HQ! - Third Space membership - Private health insurance - Multiple all-expense paid offsites per year (last 3 trips include Crete, Greece; Cancun, Mexico; Barcelona, Spain) - Visa sponsorship available
